woven-gold-hoops.before:
Texture does the talking here. These hoops measure about 25mm across and each one is a thick braided rope of gold strands, worked so the surface reads as raised ridge and shadow rather than a single smooth curve. There are no stones at all, just weight, plating and pattern. They carry a plain kurta or a work shirt without needing anything else on the ear.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with a bare neckline and loose hair so the braided texture stays the focus.

Details

  • Style: Chunky braided hoop
  • Size: Approximately 25mm across
  • Surface: Braided rope of gold tone strands with raised ridges
  • Stones: None
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

pearl-drop-studs.before:
A pearl, and a small weight below it. Each stud drops about 30mm, a round white shell pearl on the lobe with a polished gold sphere of about 18mm suspended directly beneath, so the drop swings gently as you move. The pearls are shell pearls, as the supplier does not state a natural or freshwater source. Wear them to a family function, or with a plain shirt on a working morning.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with a soft updo so the gold sphere stays clear of your collar.

Details

  • Drop: Approximately 30mm
  • Design: Round white shell pearl on the lobe with a polished gold sphere below
  • Pearl: Shell pearl, provenance not stated by the supplier
  • Sphere: Polished gold sphere, approximately 18mm
  • Fitting: Stud
  • Sold as: One pair
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

emerald-halo-c-hoops.before:
Green, ringed in light. Open C-shaped half hoops in bright silver tone, their front faces set with a row of small round emerald-green stones, each ringed in tiny clear pavé. Post backs.

STYLING TIP: Wear them with ivory or deep green.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 22mm tall
  • Stones: Small round emerald green cubic zirconia, each ringed in clear pavé
  • Shape: Open C shaped half hoop
  • Closure: Post back
  • Finish: Bright silver tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
